verdict.rationale: Milvus docs claim support for 'vector CRUD operations' [milvus-docs-17]. A community report describes newly inserted vectors being searched by brute force until a segment is indexed, which suggests new data becomes searchable quickly [milvus-comm-3, milvus-comm-2]. However, that same old thread says deletion was not yet supported and that index rebuilds were sometimes needed. Because it predates the current docs, it signals caveats rather than a concrete dispute. Missing for 10: explicit upsert documentation, documented delete semantics, documented consistency levels or freshness guarantees, and current hands-on evidence of update/delete visibility latency.
